facts.plan_summary: This is a comprehensive health insurance policy that covers medical treatment expenses incurred during hospitalization due to illness or accident. It offers a range of benefits including in-patient care, maternity, and wellness features across three plan variants: Silver, Gold, and Platinum.
facts.target_customer: Individuals and families seeking financial protection against hospitalization and related medical expenses.
facts.sum_assured_or_insured: 300,000; 5 Lacs; 7.5 Lacs; 10 Lacs; 15 Lacs; 20 Lacs; 25 Lacs; 30 Lacs; 35 Lacs; 40 Lacs; 45 Lacs; 50 Lacs; 75 Lacs; 1 Crore
facts.waiting_periods: 1. Pre-existing Diseases waiting period: 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Health Guard Policy. 2. Specified disease/procedure waiting period: 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Health Guard Policy. 3. Any Medical Expenses incurred during the first three consecutive annual periods for certain surgeries and treatments. 4. 30-day waiting period: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident. 5. Bariatric Surgery: 36 months from the date of commencement of the first Health Guard Policy.
facts.free_look_period: thirty days from date of receipt of the policy document
facts.grace_period: fifteen days (where premium is paid on a monthly instalments) and thirty days (where premium is paid in quarterly/half-yearly/annual instalments)
facts.claim_process: Complete set of claim documents needs to be forwarded to Health Administration Team, Bajaj Insurance House, 2nd floor, Bajaj Finserv Building, Behind Weikfield IT Park, Off Nagar Road, Viman Nagar-Pune - 411 014. All Claims will be settled by In house claims settlement team of the company and no TPA is engaged.
key_benefits: In-patient hospitalization including AYUSH and bariatric surgery
Maternity and newborn baby cover (Gold and Platinum only)
Sum insured reinstatement and recharge benefits
Preventive health check-up and wellness discounts
Daily cash benefit for accompanying an insured child
optional_riders_or_addons: Air Ambulance (Optional available for SI 5Lacs and above)
major_exclusions: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage.
Expenses related to the treatment of listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage.

Any Medical Expenses incurred during the first three consecutive annual periods for joint replacement surgery, surgery for vertebral column disorders, surgery to correct deviated nasal septum, hypertrophied turbinate, congenital internal diseases or anomalies, treatment for correction of eye sight due to refractive error greater or equal to 7.5, Bariatric Surgery, Parkinson's Disease, genetic disorders.
Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident.
Mental Illness (as per ICD codes listed) is subject to waiting period and specific exclusions.

Bajaj General | Health Guard | Health | Section: About Bajaj General Insurance Limited
(Formerly known as Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Co. Ltd.) Bajaj General Insurance Limited (formerly known as Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Company Limited) is one of India's leading, most trusted and dynamic private general insurance companies. It is a subsidiary of Bajaj Finserv Limited, India's leading and most diversified financial services group. Bajaj General offers a broad portfolio of innovative and customer-focused insurance solutions, spanning motor, health, and home insurance, along with specialised products such as pet insurance, wedding insurance, event protection, cyber insurance, and rural insurance. From safeguarding your health and home to protecting your travels and life's most important moments, Bajaj General aims to be a constant partner in your journey. Bajaj General equally offers a comprehensive and a well-diversified range of products, including fire, marine, engineering, liability and surety insurance to corporates and SME's. The company also participates in various government schemes with a focus on financial inclusion. The company is also known for its robust risk selection capabilities, digital adoption and product innovation. Established in 2001, the company has grown its footprint to nearly 1,500 towns and cities across India, ensuring easy access and a close connection to its customers. This access is enabled through the largest distribution network, spanning across individual agents, point-of-sales personnel, banks, NBFCs, motor dealers, brokers and the company's proprietary sales force.

It holds an [ICRA]AAA rating from ICRA Limited, reflecting the highest level of confidence in its financial strength and stability. Bajaj General | Health Guard | Health | Section: Product summary
Health Guard by Bajaj General (Health).
UIN: BAJHLIP26073V082526
Plan summary: This is a comprehensive health insurance policy that covers medical treatment expenses incurred during hospitalization due to illness or accident. It offers a range of benefits including in-patient care, maternity, and wellness features across three plan variants: Silver, Gold, and Platinum.
Who it is for: Individuals and families seeking financial protection against hospitalization and related medical expenses.
Sum assured / sum insured: 300,000; 5 Lacs; 7.5 Lacs; 10 Lacs; 15 Lacs; 20 Lacs; 25 Lacs; 30 Lacs; 35 Lacs; 40 Lacs; 45 Lacs; 50 Lacs; 75 Lacs; 1 Crore
Premium payment modes: annual single premium
Waiting periods: 1. Pre-existing Diseases waiting period: 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Health Guard Policy. 2. Specified disease/procedure waiting period: 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Health Guard Policy. 3. Any Medical Expenses incurred during the first three consecutive annual periods for certain surgeries and treatments. 4. 30-day waiting period: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident. 5. Bariatric Surgery: 36 months from the date of commencement of the first Health Guard Policy.
Free-look period: thirty days from date of receipt of the policy document
Grace period: fifteen days (where premium is paid on a monthly instalments) and thirty days (where premium is paid in quarterly/half-yearly/annual instalments)
Claim process: Complete set of claim documents needs to be forwarded to Health Administration Team, Bajaj Insurance House, 2nd floor, Bajaj Finserv Building, Behind Weikfield IT Park, Off Nagar Road, Viman Nagar-Pune - 411 014. All Claims will be settled by In house claims settlement team of the company and no TPA is engaged.
Key benefits: In-patient hospitalization including AYUSH and bariatric surgery; Maternity and newborn baby cover (Gold and Platinum only); Sum insured reinstatement and recharge benefits; Preventive health check-up and wellness discounts; Daily cash benefit for accompanying an insured child; Convalescence benefit for extended hospitalization
Optional riders / add-ons: Air Ambulance (Optional available for SI 5Lacs and above); Voluntary Aggregate Deductible; Waiver of Room Capping
Major exclusions: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage.; Expenses related to the treatment of listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage.; Any Medical Expenses incurred during the first three consecutive annual periods for joint replacement surgery, surgery for vertebral column disorders, surgery to correct deviated nasal septum, hypertrophied turbinate, congenital internal diseases or anomalies, treatment for correction of eye sight due to refractive error greater or equal to 7.5, Bariatric Surgery, Parkinson's Disease, genetic disorders.; Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident.; Mental Illness (as per ICD codes listed) is subject to waiting period and specific exclusions.; Congenital internal diseases or anomalies.
